subject: 🎓 You're on Track to Graduate — $program_name
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your latest graduation audit has come back positive — based on the record we hold right now, you are on track to complete the $program_name degree this academic session.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AUDIT SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Student ID:           $student_id
Programme:            $program_name
Audit Run On:         $audit_date

Credits Earned:       $credits_earned / $credits_required
Current GPA:          $current_gpa  (required: $gpa_required)
Requirements Met:     $completed_requirements / $total_requirements
Final Verdict:        ELIGIBLE TO GRADUATE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

  1. Submit your graduation application via the Student Portal by $apply_by (if you have not already).
  2. Clear any outstanding financial holds — the Bursar must confirm financial clearance before conferral.
  3. Order your gown and book guest tickets for the ceremony on $ceremony_date.
  4. Keep an eye out for the formal conferral notice once the Senate approves the cohort list.

IMPORTANT CAVEATS

  • This audit reflects results recorded today. Any failed final exam, withdrawn module, or late grade entry may change the outcome.
  • Conferral remains subject to Senate approval and full financial clearance.

If anything in the figures above looks wrong, contact your academic advisor straight away.

Congratulations on reaching this milestone!

Kind regards,
Office of the Registrar
